use_case_summary: Mid-market SaaS (customer-facing knowledge search) evaluating Redwood for embeddings pipeline + semantic search. Primary goals: reduce query latency, simplify nightly batch ingestion, and control unit costs compared to current managed vector DB + self-hosted encoder fleet.
technical_requirements: throughput target: 500-800 qps sustained for search endpoints
p95 latency goal: <150ms (user-facing, sub-200ms acceptable for phase 1)
batch ingest: nightly jobs ~50k-150k docs (embedding compute + upserts)
embedding model preference: open/medium or custom fine-tuned smaller embedder
vector DB: integration with Pinecone (currently), ability to export to other vector stores
multi-tenant index isolation and namespace separation
observability: token-level cost breakdown and traceability for search requests
notes: Lead: product team (CTO Paul Winters) - focused on search quality + cost predictability.
Quote: 'We need consistent 95p latency for customers in US-East; occasional 300ms spikes are killing conversion'
Initial ask: start on Hosted API to prove throughput and correctness; if cost or latency unsatisfactory consider Dedicated reservation.
POC specifics: ingest small subset (20k docs) via hosted embeddings -> Pinecone index; run canonical queries and real-customer prompts.

Observed during POC: embedding batch jobs hit rate limits on their current encoder fleet; Redwood hosted API achieved 2k embeddings/sec in parallelized runs but end-to-end pipeline (encode+upsert) slower due to Pinecone upsert throttling.
SE notes (Priya): need to capture KV-cache behavior for conversational features later; recommend enabling prefix caching once chat POC starts.
Security: legal flagged data residency for EU customers; Cedar Skein wants VPC option + KMS integration before committing to Dedicated.

Commercial: they requested a pro-forma showing Hosted costs vs. a 3-node Dedicated reservation (GPU-type: A10G equivalent) with monthly commit and burst billing. CFO loop-in planned after POC metrics.
